question: What power is attributed to the seed revealed as Vīrapatnī?
premises: A seed is revealed under the name Vīrapatnī.
This seed is described as causing the end of an age.
The revelation presents this causal power as its defining trait.
inference: The seed revealed as Vīrapatnī is the seed that causes the end of an age.
plain_english: The seed revealed as Vīrapatnī is the one that brings about the end of an age.
